LOBREGAT Zamboanga City Dear Mayor Lobregat: This pertains to your letter dated May 29, 2012 requesting for guidance on the issue of whether or not pedicabs may be allowed to use national highways or roads subject to certain conditions. Under the existing laws, pedicabs and tricycles are prohibited to operate on national highways. Under DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2011-68, tricycles may be allowed to operate along national highways, if there is no other alternative road and subject to the prescribed guideline of the DOTC. Likewise, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2007-01 Section D provides that: "For safety reasons, no tricycle or pedicab should operate on national highways utilized by 4-wheel vehicles greater than 4 tons and where normal speed exceeds 40 KPH. However, the SP/SB may allow if there is no other alternative route." Based on the above cited provisions, pedicabs may be allowed to use national highways provided that there is no other alternate route. In reply to your query, we are of the opinion that pedicabs may be allowed to use the national highways or roads to bring pupils, teachers and parents to and from the schools provided that there is NO alternate route and that the concerned Sanggunian allows the use thereof thru an enactment of ordinance. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, JES SB.DO UE Dire r 111
